## Required Documents

### From Document Checklist

**Migration Certificate** [Physical Reporting] — Conditional
Format: Original
Required for AIQ/Deemed if studied in different state.

**Provisional Allotment Letter** [Physical Reporting] — MANDATORY
Format: A4 Printout
Download from MCC/state counselling portal after allotment.

**Transfer Certificate (TC)** [Physical Reporting] — MANDATORY
Format: Original
From last school. May need DEO countersign.

**Anti-Ragging Affidavit** [Physical Reporting] — MANDATORY
Format: Stamp Paper
Both student and parent sign. Generate at antiragging.in.

**Medical Fitness Certificate** [Physical Reporting] — MANDATORY
Format: Original
From registered MBBS practitioner. Some colleges do own exam.

**Passport-size Photographs (10 copies)** [Physical Reporting] — MANDATORY
Format: Physical
White background, 3.5x4.5cm. Match NEET application photo.

**Demand Draft / Fee Payment Receipt** [Physical Reporting] — MANDATORY
Format: DD/Receipt
Confirm payee name from allotment letter.

## Required Documents

### From Document Checklist

**NEET UG Scorecard / Rank Letter** [Online Registration] — MANDATORY
Format: PDF/JPEG
Download from nta.ac.in. Both scorecard and rank letter needed.

**NEET UG Admit Card** [Online Registration] — MANDATORY
Format: PDF/JPEG
Must show photograph, roll number, and exam center.

**Class 10th Marksheet & Certificate** [Online Registration] — MANDATORY
Format: PDF/JPEG
For DOB verification. Name must match NEET application.

**Class 12th Marksheet & Certificate** [Online Registration] — MANDATORY
Format: PDF/JPEG
Must show PCB + English aggregate.

**Aadhar Card / Government Photo ID** [Online Registration] — MANDATORY
Format: PDF/JPEG
Aadhar universally accepted.

**Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS)** [Online Registration] — Conditional
Format: PDF
OBC must have non-creamy layer clause, issued within last year.

**Domicile / Residence Certificate** [Online Registration] — Conditional
Format: PDF
Required for state quota. Proves 10-15 years continuous residence.

**Provisional Allotment Letter** [Physical Reporting] — MANDATORY
Format: A4 Printout
Download from MCC/state counselling portal after allotment.

**Transfer Certificate (TC)** [Physical Reporting] — MANDATORY
Format: Original
From last school. May need DEO countersign.

**Migration Certificate** [Physical Reporting] — Conditional
Format: Original
Required for AIQ/Deemed if studied in different state.

Both student and parent sign. Generate at antiragging.in.

From registered MBBS practitioner. Some colleges do own exam.
